name: WGPT sell hook burns treasury LP before crediting the deposit
summary: AiWGPTToken.transferFrom executes its treasury-funded LP removal and exact-output WGPT purchase before crediting the caller’s deposit to the pair. The hook updates pool reserves, then credits an unconsumed deposit that the caller can reclaim with skim. Repeated calls consume treasury LP and raise the WGPT price, allowing the caller to sell the retained tokens for USDT.
notes: The reset is the owner's setIsSwap(true) (0xad140675, slot 0xa), 158 blocks before the anchor: isSwap was false from deployment, and until then transfers to and from the pair did nothing for accounts off the whitelist, the attack contract among them, so it first made the hook's path usable (rule 8). The earlier setup the hook needed was pair registration, swapLPAddr (its price source), ApprovaLp and ApprovalUsdtForRouter. setBurnToken was switched off and back on before it; setlpNumber edits only size the LP removal.

Net USDT depletion of the WGPT/USDT pair and the token contract's treasury, which received part of the removed liquidity back. The burned and fee WGPT is not valued: the attacker realised nothing from it. A scan of the pair's USDT drops over the following ~380k blocks found only ordinary sells, no repeat.
